result.instructions: Tools for Caisy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which pages in our Caisy project are not published yet?"; "List the blueprints in our Caisy project and how many documents each has."; "Find the page with slug pricing and show its title and last updated date.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Caisy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run caisy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run caisy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run caisy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. caisy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: caisy_run_query
tools.title: Run a read-only GraphQL query
tools.description: Run one read-only GraphQL query against this project's Caisy external API. Use it for any field, filter (where), sort, nested connection or localized value. Mutations and subscriptions are refused. Caisy: POST https://cloud.caisy.io/api/e/v4/<projectId>/graphql with header x-caisy-apikey.

query.description: A GraphQL query, e.g. { allPage(first: 5) { edges { node { id slug } } } }.

variables.description: Optional GraphQL variables as a JSON object.

tools.name: caisy_list_queries
tools.title: List the project's read queries
tools.description: List the top-level read fields of this project's Caisy schema: one all<Blueprint> list query per non-unique blueprint, one single-entry query per unique blueprint, and the asset query. Call it first to learn the blueprint API ids.

tools.name: caisy_list_documents
tools.title: List documents of a blueprint
tools.description: List document ids of one blueprint with Relay pagination (all<Blueprint>(first, after)). Returns ids only: call caisy_run_query for the fields you need. Unique blueprints have no list query: use caisy_run_query with the blueprint's single-entry field.

blueprint.description: The blueprint API id, e.g. Page (from caisy_list_queries).

first.description: Documents per page (1–100, default set by Caisy).

after.description: Cursor: pass pageInfo.endCursor from the previous page to get the next page.

tools.name: caisy_list_assets
tools.title: List media assets
tools.description: List media assets (title and source URL) of this project, with Relay pagination. Use the cursor from pageInfo.endCursor to read further.

first.description: Documents per page (1–100, default set by Caisy).

after.description: Cursor: pass pageInfo.endCursor from the previous page to get the next page.
